limitations: Only a compact repeller and lower entropy bound are established for the scalar map on an explicitly certified parameter band. No full attractor or planar orbit correspondence is established; possible literature-priority overlap with the later journal version remains.
scientific_integrity: The finding is an exact claim about the printed scalar family; proof of lift to the two-dimensional parent model is not supplied. Analytical contraction argument converts exact finite inequalities into the infinite symbolic conclusion.
title: Uniform two-symbol horseshoe for a discontinuous affine return family
